name: My Home Dream 2
summary: A home design and building simulation game released for the Sony PlayStation in 1999. The player can design and construct a house and garden from the ground up using the game's grid system along with selecting and arranging its room layout and furniture. Like the original My Home Dream, the game also features a 3D engine that lets you walk through your finished home to view all of your interior design choices in first person.
